newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany says give Russia full seat in NATO forum.
newsitem.headline: Germany says give Russia full seat in NATO forum.

text.p: Russia should be given equal consultation rights in a new NATO forum intended to involve Moscow in European security affairs, German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel was quoted on Saturday as saying.

The 16-member North Atlantic Treaty Organisation is already holding talks with Russia intended to allay its fears about NATO's planned admission of several eastern European countries, likely to be decided next year.
"I propose that NATO's consultations with Russia should go beyond the current 16-plus-one formula.

"The 16-plus-one ought to become a 17-member consultation committee on security, "S-17' for short, in which NATO and Russia sit at the same table with equal rights," Kinkel told Sunday's Express newspaper, according to an advance release on Saturday.
He did not, however, specify what the rights of individual committee members should be.

NATO has already insisted that Russia cannot be granted any veto over the admission of new members, and Moscow has appeared grudgingly to accept that it cannot prevent several east European countries joining the alliance.
